function warnOrderIndexFallback(collection, path, options, index) {
  if ((0,__vite_ssr_import_6__.devBuild)() && process.env.NODE_ENV !== `production`) {
    const field = path.join(`.`);
    const prefix = `[TanStack DB]${collection.id ? ` [${collection.id}]` : ``} orderBy with limit`;
    if (options.stringSort === `custom`) {
      console.warn(
        `${prefix} uses a custom string comparator on "${field}". On-demand sources require a filtered full source request for local sorting. An index with the same compare function reference can sort installed rows, but cannot make provider pagination safe.`
      );
      return;
    };
    if ((0,__vite_ssr_import_5__.hasVirtualPropPath)(path)) {
      console.warn(
        `${prefix} orders virtual field "${field}"; Collection indexes cannot cover virtual fields, so creating one will not enable ordered lazy loading.`
      );
      return;
    };
    if (index) return;
    const fieldIndexes = [...collection.indexes.values()].filter(
      (candidate) => candidate.matchesField(path)
    );
    let detail;
    if (fieldIndexes.length === 0) {
      detail = `requires an index on "${field}" for efficient lazy loading. Consider collection.createIndex((row) => row.${field}) or autoIndex: 'eager' with a defaultIndexType.`;
    } else if (fieldIndexes.every(
      (candidate) => !candidate.matchesCompareOptions(options)
    )) {
      detail = `found an index on "${field}", but none uses the query's compareOptions (nulls: "${options.nulls}", stringSort: "${options.stringSort ?? `locale`}"${options.stringSort === `locale` ? `, including the same locale and localeOptions` : ``}). After importing BasicIndex from '@tanstack/db', use collection.createIndex((row) => row.${field}, { indexType: BasicIndex, options: { compareOptions: { direction: "asc", nulls: "${options.nulls}", stringSort: "${options.stringSort ?? `locale`}" } } }). Match the query's nulls and string collation, including any locale and localeOptions. The index direction may differ.`;
    } else {
      detail = `found an index on "${field}" with matching compareOptions, but none supports ordered lazy loading. Use an index with ordered range reads, one comparable value domain, and no custom comparator.`;
    };
    console.warn(
      `${prefix} ${detail} Local reads may scan or sort installed rows; an underfilled on-demand window may require a full-source request.`
    );
  }
}
function processOrderBy(rawQuery, pipeline, orderByClause, selectClause, grouping, collection, optimizableOrderByCollections, setWindowFn, limit, offset, groupKeyFn) {
  const compiledOrderBy = orderByClause.map((clause) => {
    const clauseWithoutAggregates = grouping ? grouping.replaceAggregatesByRefs(
      clause.expression,
      selectClause,
      `$selected`
    ) : clause.expression;
    return {
      compiledExpression: (0,__vite_ssr_import_7__.compileExpression)(clauseWithoutAggregates),
      compareOptions: buildCompareOptions(clause, collection)
    };
  });
  const valueExtractor = (row) => {
    if (orderByClause.length > 1) {
      return compiledOrderBy.map((compiled) => compiled.compiledExpression(row));
    };
    return orderByClause.length === 1 ? compiledOrderBy[0].compiledExpression(row) : null;
  };
  const compare = (a, b) => {
    if (orderByClause.length > 1) {
      const arrayA = a;
      const arrayB = b;
      for (let i = 0; i < orderByClause.length; i++) {
        const clause = compiledOrderBy[i];
        const compareFn = (0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.makeComparator)(clause.compareOptions);
        const result = compareFn(arrayA[i], arrayB[i]);
        if (result !== 0) {
          return result;
        }
      };
      return arrayA.length - arrayB.length;
    };
    if (orderByClause.length === 1) {
      const clause = compiledOrderBy[0];
      const compareFn = (0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.makeComparator)(clause.compareOptions);
      return compareFn(a, b);
    };
    return (0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.defaultComparator)(a, b);
  };
  let setSizeCallback;
  let orderByOptimizationInfo;
  if (limit !== void 0 && orderByClause.length > 0 && !groupKeyFn && rawQuery.from.type !== `unionFrom` && rawQuery.from.type !== `unionAll`) {
    let index;
    let followRefCollection;
    let orderByAlias = rawQuery.from.alias;
    let orderBySourceId;
    const firstClause = orderByClause[0];
    const firstOrderByExpression = firstClause.expression;
    const followRefResult = firstOrderByExpression.type === `ref` ? (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.followRef)(rawQuery, firstOrderByExpression, collection) : void 0;
    if (firstOrderByExpression.type === `ref` && followRefResult) {
      followRefCollection = followRefResult.collection;
      orderBySourceId = followRefResult.sourceId;
      const fieldName = followRefResult.path[0];
      const compareOpts = buildCompareOptions(firstClause, collection);
      if (fieldName) {
        (0,__vite_ssr_import_3__.ensureIndexForField)(
          fieldName,
          followRefResult.path,
          followRefCollection,
          compareOpts,
          (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.supportsOrderedIndexStructure)
        );
      };
      index = (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.findIndexForField)(
        followRefCollection,
        followRefResult.path,
        compareOpts,
        (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.supportsOrderedRange)
      );
      warnOrderIndexFallback(
        followRefCollection,
        followRefResult.path,
        compareOpts,
        index
      );
      orderByAlias = firstOrderByExpression.path.length > 1 ? String(firstOrderByExpression.path[0]) : rawQuery.from.alias;
      orderBySourceId ??= (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.collectCollectionSources)(rawQuery).find(
        (source) => source.alias === orderByAlias && source.collection === followRefCollection
      )?.sourceId;
    };
    if (orderBySourceId && followRefResult) {
      const sourceOrderBy = resolveOrderBy(
        orderByClause,
        collection.compareOptions
      );
      const sourceOrderIsDirect = orderByClause.every(({ expression }) => {
        if (expression.type !== `ref`) return false;
        return (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.followRef)(rawQuery, expression, collection)?.sourceId === orderBySourceId;
      });
      const extract = (0,__vite_ssr_import_7__.compileExpression)(
        new __vite_ssr_import_2__.PropRef(followRefResult.path),
        true
      );
      const compareTerm = (0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.makeComparator)(sourceOrderBy[0].compareOptions);
      const compareSourceRows = (a, b) => compareTerm(a ? extract(a) : a, b ? extract(b) : b);
      const hasCrossAliasWhere = rawQuery.where?.some(
        (where) => [...(0,__vite_ssr_import_8__.getSourceAliasesFromExpression)((0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.getWhereExpression)(where))].some(
          (alias) => alias !== orderByAlias
        )
      ) ?? false;
      const joinedFilterSourceId = hasCrossAliasWhere && rawQuery.join?.length === 1 && rawQuery.join[0].type === `left` && rawQuery.join[0].from.type === `collectionRef` ? rawQuery.join[0].from.sourceId : void 0;
      const info = {
        sourceId: orderBySourceId,
        alias: orderByAlias,
        offset: offset ?? 0,
        limit,
        comparator: compareSourceRows,
        valueExtractorForRawRow: extract,
        index,
        orderBy: sourceOrderBy,
        joinedFilterSourceId,
        sourceHoldsAllRows: followRefResult.collection.config.syncMode !== `on-demand`,
        requiresFullSource: sourceOrderBy.some(
          ({ compareOptions }) => compareOptions.stringSort === `custom`
        ) || !sourceOrderIsDirect || rawQuery.from.type !== `collectionRef` || rawQuery.from.sourceId !== orderBySourceId || // Only a LEFT join keeps every root row of a bounded prefix and
        // adds no row the prefix cannot place: inner and cross joins drop
        // root rows, and right, full and outer joins add joined rows whose
        // root match may sit past the prefix.
        (rawQuery.join?.some(({ type }) => type !== `left`) ?? false) || (rawQuery.where?.some((0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.isResidualWhere)) ?? false) || hasCrossAliasWhere && joinedFilterSourceId === void 0 || (rawQuery.fnWhere?.length ?? 0) > 0 || rawQuery.groupBy !== void 0 || rawQuery.having !== void 0 || rawQuery.fnHaving !== void 0 || rawQuery.distinct === true
      };
      orderByOptimizationInfo = info;
      optimizableOrderByCollections[orderBySourceId] = info;
      const needsCount = info.joinedFilterSourceId !== void 0 && !info.sourceHoldsAllRows;
      if (index || needsCount) {
        setSizeCallback = (getSize) => {
          info.dataNeeded = (boundary) => {
            const size = getSize(
              boundary && ((row) => compareSourceRows(
                row[orderByAlias],
                boundary
              ) <= 0)
            );
            return Math.max(0, info.limit - size);
          };
        };
      }
    }
  };
  if (groupKeyFn) {
    return pipeline.pipe(
      (0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.groupedOrderByWithFractionalIndex)(valueExtractor, {
        limit,
        offset,
        comparator: compare,

            windowFn(options);
            if (orderByOptimizationInfo) {
              orderByOptimizationInfo.offset = options.offset ?? orderByOptimizationInfo.offset;
              orderByOptimizationInfo.limit = options.limit ?? orderByOptimizationInfo.limit;
            }
          });
        }
      })
    );
  };
  return pipeline.pipe(
    (0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.orderByWithFractionalIndex)(valueExtractor, {
      limit,
      offset,
      comparator: compare,
      setSizeCallback,
      setWindowFn: (windowFn) => {
        setWindowFn(
          // We wrap the move function such that we update the orderByOptimizationInfo
          // because that is used by the `dataNeeded` callback to determine if we need to load more data
          (options) => {
            windowFn(options);
            if (orderByOptimizationInfo) {
              orderByOptimizationInfo.offset = options.offset ?? orderByOptimizationInfo.offset;
              orderByOptimizationInfo.limit = options.limit ?? orderByOptimizationInfo.limit;
            }
          }
        );
      }
    })
    // orderByWithFractionalIndex returns [key, [value, index]] - we keep this format
  );
};
function buildCompareOptions(clause, collection) {
  return resolveCompareOptions(clause, collection.compareOptions);
};
function resolveOrderBy(orderBy, defaults) {
  return orderBy.map((clause) => ({
    expression: clause.expression,
    compareOptions: resolveCompareOptions(clause, defaults)
  }));
}
function resolveCompareOptions(clause, defaults) {
  return clause.compareOptions.stringSort === void 0 ? {
    ...defaults,
    direction: clause.compareOptions.direction,
    nulls: clause.compareOptions.nulls
  } : clause.compareOptions;
}
